property_summary: For any valid input, the transfer function must return the same value as the reference implementation; the mutant incorrectly returns false instead of true.
For any admissible input where the call completes without reverting, the transfer function must return true in the reference contract; the mutant instead returns false.
For any input that does not revert, the reference returns true, but the mutant incorrectly returns false.

For any admissible input that completes without reverting, the return value of transfer must equal the result of the call to caddress not reverting (i.e., true when the external call succeeds, false when it fails); the mutant always returns false regardless of the external call outcome.
